redemption.specialInstructions:
Please let us know where you would like to be picked up at least 48 hours before departure & please bring identification in case confirmation that guests are of legal drinking age is needed. Pick-up times range from 9:30am to 10:45 am based on your pick-up location. Pick-up times will be confirmed via email the day prior to your trip. It is important for you to review your email after 5pm the day prior to your tour to confirm your pick-up time.

If we do not hear from you with a pickup location 48 hours or more in advance, we will pick you up at the Garden Street Visitor's Center at 1 Garden St., Santa Barbara, CA 93101.

While we have reusable water bottles available for your use, you are encouraged to bring your own if preferred. 

Gratuity: Our guides do their best to ensure you have a great time. It is customary, but optional, to tip your guide if you had a positive experience. Guide gratuity is not included in your reservation fee (unless you opted to pre-book gratuity) and should may be paid directly to your guide (15-20% is standard). We are also happy to apply additional gratuity via credit card at any time by calling our office. 

Waiver Required:
To help speed up the check-in process, please use the link below to have all guests complete their waivers prior to arrival. Each guest must have their own signed waiver and the same link can be used for each guest: https://tinyurl.com/WineWaiver

Lunch:
Must be submitted to letsgo@sbadventureco.com at least 48 hours prior to trip departure or selections will be made for you. The lunch menu is linked below. Guests may opt for a sandwich OR salad via email with the number(s) associated with the sandwich or the name of the salad they would prefer. 

Menu: 
https://tinyurl.com/PaninosLosOlivosMenu

Typical Itinerary:
• Hotel Pickups — 9:30-10:45am
• Tour:
 + 1st Winery Tasting — 11:00am - 12:00pm
 + 2nd Winery Tasting & Lunch — 12:30-2:15pm
 + 3rd Winery Tasting — 2:30-3:30pm
• Hotel Dropoffs — 4:45-5:15pm

travelerPickup.additionalInfo:
We pick up/drop off at all hotels, vacation rentals and private accommodations in Santa Barbara and the Santa Ynez Valley. Alternatively, you can meet us at the 1 Garden St parking lot, Santa Barbara. 

Directions to the Garden St. Parking Lot

From the South: Take Hwy 101 North toward Santa Barbara. As you enter the Santa Barbara area, exit at 96B Garden St./Laguna. Keep left to take the Garden St. ramp. Turn left onto Garden St. Drive .4 mi. across the train tracks and turn right. Park in the lot (1 Garden St., at the intersection of Cabrillo and Garden). Parking fees may apply. Your wine guide will meet you in the parking lot by the restrooms.

From the North: Take Hwy 101 South toward Santa Barbara. As you enter the Santa Barbara area take the Garden St. Exit, 96B. Turn right at the end of the off-ramp onto Garden St. Drive .4 mi. across the train tracks and turn right. Park in the lot (1 Garden St., at the intersection of Cabrillo and Garden). Parking fees may apply. Your wine guide will meet you in the parking lot by the restrooms.

product.description: Taste some of California's best wines on this award-winning tour of Santa Barbara Wine Country. Enjoy breathtaking views on the way to Santa Ynez Valley on board a luxury passenger van. Our knowledgeable guide will share facts and history about our amazing wine region while you visit our partner wineries.

inclusions.description: Delicious locally sourced lunch and cold beverages

inclusions.otherDescription: Discussion on winemaking and historical insights
Shuttle pick-up & drop-off from your hotel or accommodations in Santa Barbara or Santa Ynez Valley

additionalInfo.description: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Public transportation options are available nearby
Suitable for all physical fitness levels

cancellationPolicy.description: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.

itineraryItems.description:
Explore the stunning vineyards and quaint towns of the Santa Ynez Valley while our guide shares some of the history and wine production secrets of the valley. We will visit three full production wineries and lunch will be enjoyed amidst the vineyards.

We spend about an hour at each winery and allow approximately an hour for lunch at one of those stops. 

We have a few "local favorites" that we may visit on this tour, with great reviews from our clients and guides. You can read more about our partner wineries on our website.
